en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 33. And from the previous chain from Salih b. al-Harith b. al-Mughira from Abi Abdillah (a.s.)
who said: ‘O guest of Allah! There are glad-tidings of my friendship in Paradise for you’.
Then Ali (a.s.) calls out, ‘I guarantee the fulfillment of your desires in this world and the hereafter and keeping calamities away from you’.
Then all the angels would surround him in a circle and accompany him home.”
